headline: Digjam Limited holds NCLT-convened shareholder meeting
sum: Digjam Limited held a shareholders meeting convened by the National Company Law Tribunal on 16 August 2026, signalling an insolvency or corporate restructuring proceeding under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.
implication: NCLT-convened shareholders meetings typically precede liquidation, revival schemes, or resolution plan voting under IBC; the proceeding's outcome will determine whether the company's equity is preserved or creditors take priority.
detail: The company formally notified the National Stock Exchange of the proceedings held on 16 August 2026. NCLT convenes shareholders' meetings in insolvency contexts when a company is subject to moratorium, undergoes restructuring, or moves toward liquidation under Part II of the IBC 2016. The exact resolution voted upon-whether a resolution plan, liquidity plan, or member distribution scheme-is contained in the detailed meeting proceedings filed with the exchange.

central - if meeting approved liquidation, this governs creditor payout hierarchy and equity write-down

framework.ref: IBC 2016, Section 14 (Moratorium on prosecution of suits; stay of proceedings)

structure.novel: NCLT-convened shareholders' meetings in insolvency are procedurally distinct from statutory company meetings; voting rights and quorum may be modified by NCLT order.
